newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's CDC sees 1997 result similar to 1996.
newsitem.headline: France's CDC sees 1997 result similar to 1996.

text.p: State-owned Caisse des Depots et Consignations (CDC) expects to show a 1997 profit close to the 3.97 billion francs net attributable profit recorded for 1996, managing director Philippe Lagayette said on Tuesday.

"The group's earnings capacity is solid for the years to come," he told a news conference. "For this year, barring a major change in the situation in the financial markets, the group expects a result of the same order of magnitude as 1996."
The CDC reported 1996 results up 90 percent from 1995. Return on equity was 7.6 percent, or 10.2 percent stripping out general interest charges which cut into profit, it said.
